summary.text: Becky Lynn Stille is the Democratic nominee for Nebraska's 3rd District. A South Sioux City resident, she works as a quality manager for Ag Processing Inc and is described in local news coverage as a lifelong Nebraskan, mother, and grandmother. She is running on a platform that includes labor-union support, reproductive-healthcare access, secure borders, and Second Amendment rights paired with violence prevention.

paragraphs.text: Stille is a South Sioux City resident and farmer, according to a local news report, which describes her as a lifelong Nebraska resident, mother, and grandmother.

That report says she works as a quality manager for Ag Processing Inc (AGP), and it quotes her campaign website as saying she went "from being a single teenage mother to her current position where she earns a six-figure salary."
The Nebraska Examiner, reporting in September 2025, described her as an agricultural lab tech living in South Sioux City.
Stille had announced her candidacy by August 2025, when a local news report described her as the only Democrat running in 2026 for the seat.
She was unopposed in the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary.
